title: Multicenter Registry for Individuals with Clonal Hematopoiesis with Accompanying Biomaterial Repository
summary:
This study aims to collect detailed information about people who have a condition called clonal hematopoiesis (CH), where certain blood cells carry genetic changes. Researchers want to understand how common this is, what kinds of genetic changes happen, and gather information about many affected individuals.
Besides that, the study will look for connections between having CH and health outcomes, like other diseases. They will also collect blood or tissue samples from these people to help future research that might explain how CH causes disease, create new tests for it, or find better treatments.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Signed informed consent
- Presence of a somatic genetic alteration in blood cells or bone marrow, fulfilling the diagnostic criteria of clonal hematopoiesis as defined in the WHO classification of haematolymphoid tumours, 5 th edition, 2022 (for clarity: with or without accompanying cytopenia and irrespective of the method by which the alteration was detected).
Exclusion criteria:
- Confirmed diagnosis of a myeloid neoplasm (e.g. myelodysplastic neoplasia [MDS], myeloproliferative neoplasm [MPN], myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm [MDS/MPN] or acute myeloid leukemia [AML]) before inclusion, as defined in the WHO classification of haematolymphoid tumours, 5 th edition, 2022. For clarity, for subjects with cytopenia or other abnormal lab results, a bone marrow examination is not mandatory before inclusion in this registry.
- Cognitive, mental or other disorder, inability to read or understand German, or any other condition that renders the subject unable to provide informed consent.
